additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453763-DC/Si-D/CZ- [MP / NN 170000045] Charging cable error CRM:02832000534
additional_info.body:
Dear Milan,
Sorry for the delay.
As you have showed us, this charger has the following errors.
DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan/Pump -> ErrorCode 1  ->
Cable Good Signal HW IO Digital Input Lost while Charging OFF
DC2_CoolingUnit_EP1_Fan/Pump -> ErrorCode 4 ->
Cable Good Signal CAN Bus Lost while CAN communication is OK
DC2: ErrorCode 5 ->
Outlet not ready - HPC charging cable cooling error
These errors combined shows there is a problem on communication with the micro controller inside the plug.
There is only two possible root causes for this:
Check the connector XD12. disconnect and connect again.
If the problem remains, please replace the plug XD101.
Please proceed to replace the plug.
I will send this ticket to your queue for the work onsite to be performed.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Laura Martins,
Please do not change the subject of this email when replying to it.
